title: SensitivityProfile
description: Content sensitivity policy. SACRED — Goal Profile cannot loosen these thresholds. Sensitivity violations trigger RE-PLAN only; cannot be FORCE-RESOLVED. Required for autonomous content generation. See core-ontology-v3.md §12 and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Phase 4 T4.4.

content_rating.description: Overall content rating for books using this profile.

age_floor.description: Minimum character age for any romantic or sexual content. Sacred — violations = RE-PLAN.

heat_ceiling.description: Maximum heat level allowed. goal_profile and romance_module heat_level must not exceed this. Sacred.

topic_policies.description: Policy per content topic. Goal Profile can only tighten (set to forbidden or required_warning) — never loosen.

additionalProperties.description: Policy: forbidden=REJECT if present; permitted=allowed; required_warning=allowed with content warning; required_thoughtful=allowed with sensitivity review gate.

no_fly_topics.description: Additional topic strings that are forbidden for this profile (extends topic_policies forbidden entries). Sacred.

content_warnings.description: Content warnings that must be appended to the published manuscript if any matching content is present.

vocabulary_restrictions.description: Terms forbidden regardless of context (e.g. slurs). Extends voice_profile no_fly_words with sacred status.

representation_policy.description: Policies for depicting marginalized groups. Stub — expand during Phase 4 T4.4 implementation.

validation_hooks.description: When sensitivity checks are applied. Stub — expand during Phase 8 Sensitivity Critic implementation.
